en.headline: West Kowloon picnic festival runs its final weekend
en.dek: The West Kowloon Cultural District lists the picnic festival through Sunday, closing a run that began in mid-September.
body: The West Kowloon Cultural District lists its picnic festival as running until Sunday, the last weekend of a programme dated from 18 September to 11 October.

The district's public programme page places the festival alongside events at the Art Park, the harbourside lawns between the museums and the performance venues. The listing does not attach a separate ticket price to the picnic dates.

Sunday is also the close of the current date range published by the district. Visitors checking plans for the weekend can confirm times and any site rules on the West Kowloon programme page before going.
The same page lists other October dates at the district, including the FIRSTborn dance series through Tuesday and a Hong Kong Philharmonic collaboration at WestK Performing Arts on 12 October.

zh.headline: 西九野餐節進入最後週末 周日結束
zh.dek: 西九文化區網頁列出野餐節由九月中開至周日，今個週末是節期最後兩天。
body: 西九文化區網頁把西九野餐節列於週日結束，節期由9月18日開至10月11日，今個週末是最後兩天。
節目表把野餐節放在藝術公園一帶的活動之列。藝術公園有海濱草坪，位於博物館與演藝場地之間。網頁這一項並沒有另列門票價錢。
周日也是西九目前公佈日期的結束日。打算周末前往的市民，可先查西九節目頁，確認開放時段及場地安排。
同一網頁亦列出十月其他節目，包括進行中、周二結束的FIRSTborn舞蹈系列，以及12日西九演藝與香港管弦樂團合作的演出。
